info.name: 15. Vehicle Purchase & EMI
info.description:
Vehicle purchase and EMI/loan payment tracking endpoints.

## Access Control
- **Owner** and **General Manager** only

## Features
- Record cash/loan purchases
- Auto-generate EMI schedule
- Track EMI payments
- Minimal manual entry (only amount + date required)

## Payment Types
- `cash`: Full payment at purchase
- `loan`: Financed with EMI

## EMI Entry Types
- `scheduled`: Auto-generated from loan
- `manual`: User recorded after paying
- `app_payment`: Paid via app (future)
- `auto_debit`: Bank auto-debit

item.name: Create Purchase (Cash)
item.description:
Record a cash purchase for a vehicle.

**Required fields:**
- purchase_date (DD-MM-YYYY or ISO)
- purchase_price
- payment_type: `cash`

item.name: Create Purchase (Loan)

body.raw:
{
    "purchase_date": "10-01-2025",
    "purchase_price": 2500000,
    "payment_type": "loan",
    "vendor_name": "Mahindra Showroom",
    "invoice_number": "INV-2025-002",
    "down_payment": 500000,
    "loan_amount": 2000000,
    "interest_rate": 9.5,
    "tenure_months": 60,
    "emi_amount": 42000,
    "loan_start_date": "10-02-2025",
    "financier_name": "HDFC Bank",
    "loan_account_number": "LOAN123456789",
    "bank_name": "HDFC Bank",
    "bank_account_number": "XXXX1234",
    "bank_ifsc": "HDFC0001234",
    "auto_debit_enabled": true,
    "notes": "60 month EMI plan"
}

item.description:
Record a loan purchase for a vehicle. Auto-generates EMI schedule when loan_start_date is provided.

**Required for loan:**
- purchase_date, purchase_price, payment_type=loan
- loan_amount, tenure_months, emi_amount

**When loan_start_date is provided:**
System auto-generates pending EMI records with due dates.

item.name: Get Purchase
item.description: Get purchase details for a vehicle including loan information and payment summary.

item.name: Get Loan Summary
item.description: Get comprehensive loan summary for a vehicle including EMIs paid, remaining, overdue, outstanding balance.

item.name: Get Vehicle EMI History
item.description:
Get EMI payment history for a specific vehicle.

**Filters:**
- status: pending, paid, overdue

item.name: Record EMI (Minimal)
item.description:
Record EMI payment with minimal fields.

**Required fields (only 2!):**
- vehicle_purchase_id
- amount
- payment_date (DD-MM-YYYY or ISO 8601)

Use this when user pays EMI via netbanking/bank and records in app.

item.name: Record EMI (Full Details)

body.raw:
{
    "vehicle_purchase_id": 1,
    "amount": 42500,
    "payment_date": "10-02-2026",
    "emi_number": 1,
    "principal_amount": 28000,
    "interest_amount": 14000,
    "late_fee": 500,
    "payment_mode": "netbanking",
    "payment_source": "HDFC NetBanking - Savings Account",
    "transaction_ref": "UTR123456789",
    "notes": "Paid with late fee"
}

item.description:
Record EMI payment with all details.

**Payment modes:** cash, netbanking, upi, auto_debit, cheque, other

item.name: Record Prepayment
item.description: Record extra payment towards loan principal.

item.name: List All Payments
item.description:
List all loan payments across all vehicles.

**Filters:**
- vehicle_id
- vehicle_purchase_id
- status: pending, paid, overdue

item.name: Get Payment
item.description: Get details of a specific loan payment.

item.name: Update Payment
item.description: Update an existing loan payment record.

item.name: Delete Payment
item.description: Delete a loan payment. Only Owner can delete.

item.name: Get Upcoming EMIs
item.description:
Get EMIs due in the next N days (default 30).

Returns total amount due across all vehicles.

item.name: Get Overdue EMIs
item.description: Get all overdue EMIs. Automatically marks pending EMIs past due date as overdue.

item.name: Mark Scheduled EMI as Paid
item.description:
Mark a scheduled (auto-generated) EMI as paid.

**Required:**
- payment_date

Use when user wants to update a pending scheduled EMI to paid status.
